claim_distinctions.claim: The four-point post directly comments on the saved Railway interview
claim_distinctions.basis: Same guest, host/video context, four themes match publisher passages.

claim_distinctions.claim: Zero signup means no identity or authentication required
claim_distinctions.basis: Official SSH page documents first-time signup/sign-in and key approval; Priority Boarding access.

claim_distinctions.claim: Railway said it buys third-party listicle placements using Linkdr
claim_distinctions.basis: P134 mentions recommendation work without a method; listicle sales links belong to creator commentary.

claim_distinctions.claim: Seven-person stated team does no manual outreach
claim_distinctions.basis: P092–P106 gives seven roles and system-building; does not rule out manual outreach.

claim_distinctions.claim: Paid placements caused the reported ARR growth
claim_distinctions.basis: No causal attribution, source panel, campaign data or Linkdr customer evidence supplied.
